10.sourceTitle: Schwalbe Clik Valve | H&S Bike-Discount GmbH
10.evidenceText: Multiple prices found across two sources: bike-discount.de lists 49.99€, 33.99€, 16.95€, 11.99€, 5.95€, 3.79€, 16.95€, 9.99€. ebike24.com lists 16.99€, 13.90€, 13.99€, 11.90€, 9.95€, 7.90€. Median of all 14 prices: 12.95€
10.extractionRationale: Extracted all retail prices (both RRP and sale prices) for Clik Valve products from two German retailers. The median price was calculated from 14 individual prices ranging from 3.79€ to 49.99€. The median represents the middle value between the 7th price (11.99€) and 8th price (13.90€) when ordered sequentially.

27.evidenceText: Three distinct product listings identified: (1) p1859948.html - 40mm valve, (2) p1859949.html - 60mm valve, (3) p1859950.html - 80mm valve. Source 4 (p1859953.html) is excluded as it includes pump head adapter. Source 5 is a category page, not a product listing.
27.extractionRationale: Counted unique product page URLs for Clik Valve. Excluded p1859953 (contains pump head adapter accessory) and the category page. The three remaining URLs represent distinct valve length variants (40mm, 60mm, 80mm) as separate product listings.

37.evidenceText: Product information Features Size guide Specifications Spare parts Find a dealer
37.extractionRationale: While the source page indicates a "Spare parts" section exists, the actual inventory of replacement/spare part SKUs is not provided in the available content. The page mentions spare parts are available but does not list specific SKUs, valve cores, seals, o-rings, or replacement kits.

45.evidenceText: All DT Swiss wheelsets are tubeless compatible and the ASM versions come tubeless ready, equipped with tubeless tape and valves... The DT Swiss tubeless valve perfectly matches DT Swiss rims, to ensure a perfect seal for long, hassle-free rides.
45.extractionRationale: DT Swiss uses their proprietary DT Swiss tubeless valve as standard in their wheelsets, not the Clik valve. The available evidence only covers DT Swiss and shows 0 major brands have adopted Clik valve standard. No information about other brands (Mavic, Hunt, Zipp, ENVE, Roval) 2026/2027 product lines was found in the provided sources.

49.evidenceText: Clik valve appears in specifications for Bergamont Grandurance 10 across all five comparison pages. No other bicycle models in the comparisons explicitly list Clik valve in their specifications.
49.extractionRationale: Based on the five comparison pages provided from 99spokes.com, only the Bergamont Grandurance 10 model explicitly lists "Clik valve" in its specifications. While this model appears across multiple comparison pages, it represents a single unique bicycle model. The other bikes compared (Giant Revolt Advanced 2, Trek Checkpoint SL 5, Cannondale Topstone Carbon 3, Liv Devote Advanced 2, BULLS Machete RX 1, Canyon Grizl CF 7, Specialized Diverge 4 Sport Carbon) do not have Clik valve mentioned in their specifications.

50.evidenceText: Based on analysis of 5 provided sources: (1) https://www.schwalbe.com/en/press/clik-valve, (2) https://schwalbe.com/clik-valve-ventil (http and https variants counted as 1), (3) https://www.schwalbe.com/en/clik-valve, (4) https://www.schwalbe.com/en/SCHWALBE-CLIK-VALVE-TUBELESS-VENTIL-3530
50.extractionRationale: Counted distinct unique URLs across the 5 sources provided. Sources 2 and 3 represent the same page with different protocols (http vs https), so counted as 1 distinct page. This yields 4 distinct Clik valve technical/product pages on schwalbe.com: the press page, German product page, English main product page, and tubeless ventil product page.

56.evidenceText: The SCV butyl tubes No. 3, 4, 6, 7, 10, 12, 13, 15, 17, and 19 are equipped with the Schwalbe Clik Valve as standard
56.extractionRationale: Source 3 directly lists all SCV butyl tube models equipped with the Clik Valve. Counting the numbered models (3, 4, 6, 7, 10, 12, 13, 15, 17, 19) yields 10 distinct inner tube SKUs. This is the authoritative source stating which tubes have the Clik Valve as standard equipment.

62.sourceTitle: Rio Tinto, Century Aluminum raise US aluminum premiums 12%
62.evidenceText: The US Midwest premium, which is added to global benchmarks for aluminum delivery to that region, reached a record $1.1325 per pound.
